Name: Extra Trees for the Blue Grass Recolor
Author: inmognito
Description:
This is an add-on to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53298111?tab=user+files]Colling's[/url] lovely [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635?tab=description]Blue Grass Recolor[/url] mod, adding assets for Pine, Mahogany and Palm trees, which weren't available in the original recolour.

Pine and Mahogany assets are recoloured from [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/rues-creepy-curios-and-spooky-aesthetics-updated-11-7.126419/]Rues Creepy Curios and Spooky Aesthetics[/url]. Palm assets are recoloured from the game.

Many thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53298111?tab=user+files]Colling[/url] for letting me play in their sandbox!

[b]Installation
[/b][list=1]
[*]Unzip the mod and paste it in to your Mods folder.
[*]If you have the Blue Grass Recolor it will replace the game's pine, mahogany and palm assets with the versions from this mod.

[*]That's it!
[/list]
[b]Configuration

[/b]The mod has no config.  However, it won't display the recoloured assets unless you also have  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635?tab=description]Blue Grass Recolor[/url]﻿ installed.
